function.name: game_find_best_weapon
function.description: Finds the best weapon in the inventory to use against a particular enemy type based on the player's level and the enemy's strength and weaknesses. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

enemy_type.description: The type of enemy the player is facing.

message.content: In most cases, a **sword** (or a high‑damage melee weapon) is the most effective choice against a dragon in DragonSlayer. It deals significant damage quickly and can exploit the dragon’s vulnerability to physical attacks. If you’re at a very low level or don’t have a suitable sword, a **bow** or ranged weapon can also work well, especially if you can keep your distance.
